title: Geometry
tagline: Perimeter and area of rectangles, squares and triangles.

skills.title: Perimeter
skills.objective: Find the distance around a rectangle or square.

skills.title: Area
skills.objective: Find the area of a rectangle or triangle.

levels.title: Perimeter
levels.objective: Add up every side to find the perimeter.

lesson.intro: The perimeter is the distance all the way round a shape.
steps: A rectangle has two lengths and two widths.
Write the number only: the question says the units.

example.question: A rectangle is 9 cm by 4 cm. Find its perimeter.

levels.title: Area
levels.objective: Multiply to find the area of a rectangle, and halve it for a triangle.

lesson.intro: Area is the space inside a shape, measured in squares.
steps: Triangle: area = ½ × base × perpendicular height.
Area is in square units, like cm².

example.question: A triangle has base 6 cm and height 5 cm. Find its area.

lesson.remember: A triangle is half a rectangle.

levels.title: Measurement Challenge
levels.objective: Choose the right formula, and use it.

lesson.intro: Read carefully: is it the distance round, or the space inside?
steps: A square's side times itself is its area.

example.question: A square has an area of 25 cm². Find its perimeter.
